## What it solves

### Memory & context

> pace — ask about your files, notes and canvas and get answers that cite their sources; it drafts new documents, sheets and decks, and builds a small tool on the canvas when you need one.

### MCP support

> preadsheets, presentations, PDF and code in the browser, and an AI that edits real Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with you.

### Self-hostable

> th 2.1 authorization server (PKCE, client ID metadata documents, dynamic registration): your app can sign people in with their MR Office account and act with the scopes they allow.

### GUI / desktop app

> ository publishes the source code of its editors: the same editors MR Office runs, which you can build, run and embed on your own.

### Cross-agent support

> Mentions Codex, Copilot, Cursor
